briefdescription.para: Implementation of the terminal pipeline orchestrator.

detaileddescription.para: Implements Processor — the Controller that owns Video (terminal state machine), CellFifo (reader→message bridge), Parser, and Model&. The PTY-side TTY is owned by Processor and created by startTTY().

sect3.title: Thread contexts used in this file

listitem.para: MESSAGE THREAD — JUCE message loop; all public methods except process().
READER THREAD — byte source (terminal::Session onBytes or IPC); only process().
